counting_rules.queries: Every search expression counts once, including metadata searches. Failed and unproductive searches remain in the log. No new search after resuming.
counting_rules.content_record_checks: Each explicit open attempt counts once, including 502 failures. Incidental text in search responses is disclosed as indexed-only, not a successful body check.
counting_rules.legal_text_access: Distinct preliminary source records with a successful lawful full-text retrieval / all preliminary source records attempted (six per candidate). This measures demonstrated access in this run, not whether the work is legally available elsewhere. No denominators may shrink to remove failures; editions may count as separate access endpoints but never as independent historical lineages.
counting_rules.held_out_candidates: Distinct potentially relevant atlas works exposed by the metadata search, including incidentally returned excluded works; conservative accounting includes three for B.
counting_rules.independence: Same sender, archive-producing agency, ancient text, translation or dependent retelling cannot multiply political lineages. Gazetteers identify places; archaeology establishes finds, dates and occupation unless it explicitly attests political relations.
counting_rules.gate: All gates must pass. Unverified judgments fail closed. Potential relations remain discovery leads; the code cannot verify historical interpretation.

existing_state.held_out: Both existing prospective registers remain permanently sealed; no content opened.
existing_state.crusader: All tracked case artifacts unchanged; no new reconstruction or evaluation run.

protocol_deviations.description: The initial execution used eight research searches plus one metadata search per candidate. On an inclusive reading each used 9/8 queries; metadata searches are a sub-budget, not free extra searches. No further queries were made after correction.
B metadata search exposed three distinct atlas works despite the two-candidate cap. All are excluded; none was opened. Incidental results are retained in conservative budget accounting.

An uncommitted Amarna skeleton and SHA-256 manifest were created before demonstrated hard-gate compliance. The draft incorrectly promoted prospective uninspected lineages, name lists and snippets to passed criteria. It was removed before any commit; the relative-phase schema extension was also withdrawn. No valid preregistration or fourth case exists.

B-C06 opened an illustrated Gutenberg book through a text reader without prior section-level isolation. Returned passages were narrative text; no image or map page was selected. Hidden or omitted content cannot be audited from the returned excerpts, so a comprehensive clean-browsing claim is withheld.

map_access_audit.observed_scope: Text-mode web search and twelve explicit text/catalog open attempts. No known historical territorial map body, map page, plate, vector or derived boundary was intentionally fetched or inspected. Search output did contain incidental front-cover image markers, recorded below; no pixels were displayed by an image/screenshot tool.
map_access_audit.limit: Search extraction and unrequested snippets are not controllable evidence of a perfectly blind browsing history. Excluded records and the unscreened illustrated HTML request prevent an unqualified assertion of total non-exposure.
map_access_audit.polygons_generated_scope: No candidate polygon or new historical reconstruction. The unchanged full regression suite may generate synthetic and copied-case geometry under temporary test directories; these are not candidate inputs or research outputs.

Incidental front-cover markers for Balestracci and a modern Villani reprint; incidental PDFs and history-page snippets. No associated image or PDF opened; no cartographic label or legend content identified in returned passages.

candidates.incidental_results: Unrequested history, archival PDF and book snippets appeared. Only the six explicitly opened records entered the preliminary-source set. Later chronicle retellings and general fonds discovery do not supply independently checked 1259 acts.

isolation_review.rationale: Excluded cover-marker records plus the unscreened illustrated HTML request prevent certifying a complete clean search history. No known map-body passage was used.

stable_temporal_phase.rationale: No individual archival act or ledger entry was inspected to freeze late 1259 or the eve of Montaperti. The texts alone supply a changing campaign sequence.

spatial_model_fit.rationale: Potential center/terrain fit remains hypothetical until comune control and contado jurisdiction are distinguished from alliance, military presence and battle.

no_dynamic_dependency.rationale: The available 1259–1260 narrative paths emphasize revolt, supply and military movement. This run did not establish a stable jurisdictional state.

candidates.unconfirmed_lineage_leads: Firenze Diplomatico and Siena Capitoli/Concistoro/Consiglio Generale offer catalog paths only; no target-year instrument checked. Continuous agency ledgers would remain one producing-agency lineage unless independence were demonstrated.
